entries.name: ExtensionErrorCode
entries.doc: Why a call came back without its answer. `permission-denied`: the manifest does not ask for the permission. `no-project`: no project with a folder is open. `no-canvas`: no canvas is in front. `not-found`: what it names is not there. `outside-project`: a path leaves the project folder. `refused`: the machine or the person said no. `limit`: too many calls in a while. `timeout`: no answer in time. `unavailable`: the machine, or `server/`, cannot answer now. `failed`: anything else, with its message.
entries.code:
export type ExtensionErrorCode =
    | 'permission-denied'
    | 'no-project'
    | 'no-canvas'
    | 'not-found'
    | 'outside-project'
    | 'refused'
    | 'limit'
    | 'timeout'
    | 'unavailable'
    | 'failed';

entries.name: Result
entries.doc: What a call that can fail answers: its value, or why not. Only a wrong argument throws. A call with nothing to answer, a `Result<void>`, answers `{ ok: true, value: undefined }` with the key `value` there.
entries.code: export type Result<Value, Code extends string = ExtensionErrorCode> = { ok: true; value: Value } | { ok: false; error: { code: Code; message: string } };

entries.code: export type Returned<Value> = Value extends undefined | void ? null : Value;

entries.doc: What the machine and the person answer the client in a test. A call that asks the machine gets what it was asked and returns the value; throw `refusal(code, message)` to answer a failure. A call nothing answers is `unavailable`, except where the test host keeps the state itself: the canvas, views, storage, settings, and what an agent reads of a node with `text`.

createTestHost
entries.doc: A client of Ruimte in this process, with a project in memory you seed: it loads `client/index.ts` afresh, records what the extension defines and does, answers what you script and refuses with the permissions of your manifest, in the messages and codes Ruimte gives. What it loaded speaks for it, and a file your test imports itself speaks for the test host created last.

entries.name: TestServerAnswers

entries.name: TestServerOptions
TestAsk
entries.doc: A call of `server/` to the machine, with what it was answered.

entries.name: Method
TestServer
createTestServer
entries.doc: Loads `server/index.ts` in this process, against the machine of a test: storage in memory, answers you script and the permissions of your manifest, refused with the messages and codes Ruimte gives. Each test server loads `server/index.ts` afresh, with every file of your project it imports, so no state carries over; a package from `node_modules` loads once. What it loaded speaks for it, and a file your test imports itself speaks for the test server created last.
entries.code: export function createTestServer<Api = Record<string, (...args: never[]) => Promise<unknown>>>(options?: TestServerOptions): Promise<TestServer<Api>>;
